newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Price of Hungary's Gardenia shares set at $8.30.
newsitem.headline: Price of Hungary's Gardenia shares set at $8.30.

text.p: The dollar subscription price of the share offering of Hungarian curtain factory Gardenia is $8.30 per share, the company said on Monday in the Budapest Stock Exchange's (BSE) official gazette.
Gardenia completed an earlier statement, in which it announced that the subscription price was set at 1,465 forints/share.

All shares are registered and ordinary and the subscription period will run between March 10 and 21. The offering includes the sale of 222,000 shares with 500 forints face value and the issue of 400,000 new shares.

Gardenia recently received a go-ahead from the Budapest Stock Exchange's council on Monday to list its shares. The time of the listing depends on when the company fulfil certain technical conditions set up by the BSE.
